description: Cross-run concurrency limit keyed on a named pool. Wraps a Dagster asset with an acquire/release protocol backed by AssetObservation events on a synthetic pool asset key (__pool_<pool_key>). Multiple assets sharing the same pool_key share one concurrency counter — solves RPA-bot license overrun (fixed number of UiPath / Automation Anywhere / Blue Prism seats vs Dagster fan-out). on_capacity: wait (poll then RetryRequested) | skip (log + no-op) | fail (dg.Failure). Stale acquires older than ttl_seconds auto-expire so killed runs don't permanently hold slots. Borrows the event-log state pattern from partition_lock_asset.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Emits acquire/release AssetObservations to a synthetic __pool_<pool_key> asset key. On skip: metadata.pool_at_capacity=true.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset that gets wrapped with the pool lock.

pool_key.label: Pool Key
pool_key.description: Named pool identifier (e.g. 'uipath_bot_pool_prod'). Assets sharing this key share the same concurrency counter.

max_concurrent.label: Max Concurrent
max_concurrent.description: Max simultaneously-running holders allowed to occupy the pool.

on_capacity.label: On Capacity
on_capacity.description: 'wait' polls then RetryRequested; 'skip' returns MaterializeResult(pool_at_capacity=true); 'fail' raises dg.Failure.

wait_interval_seconds.label: Wait Interval Seconds
wait_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between pool-availability polls when on_capacity='wait'.

max_wait_attempts.label: Max Wait Attempts
max_wait_attempts.description: Max in-run polls before RetryRequested (in-run wait ceiling ~= wait_interval_seconds * max_wait_attempts).

ttl_seconds.label: TTL Seconds
ttl_seconds.description: Stale-acquire expiry. Unreleased acquire older than this is treated as released (auto-expiry for killed runs).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Optional upstream asset key (slash-separated for nested keys).

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO start date when partition_type is set.

name: RPA Queue Concurrency Lock
